bots.methodical: Spends all affordable gold, distributes fighters by lane defense, one then two medics, 4s preparation, encouragement and sticky honey.
bots.casual: 1–3 random unlocked affordable purchases per wave, random legal positions, 1s preparation, 50% of waves use powers.
bots.novice: One inexpensive random unlocked purchase per wave, clustered rear positions, 1s preparation, no healing policy or powers.

method.pairing: Same mission/configuration seed across all bots; fixed shuffled assignment across factors, one seed per mission/configuration.
method.limitations: Descriptive simulations of three scripted policies; no statistical independence across paired bots, no exhaustive seed coverage and no claim about children’s enjoyment.
